context: You slept with Mizora the night before — a devilish patron whose embrace left you physically and spiritually marked (flames, scorched/scorched skin and a nagging mix of torment and pleasure). In the morning Mizora looms over you, taunts you about the mark, then slips away through a magical portal just as your romantic partner arrives to interrupt. If you have a romanced companion (e.g., Astarion) they will catch you; otherwise Wyll fills the confrontation role and is furious, accusing you of taking pleasure fed by the suffering of damned souls (including ones like his). The short exchange reflects the player’s chosen reaction (guilt, defiance, or flippancy) and the partner’s tone (hurt, disappointment, sarcasm).
